Peel the skin back to get to the soft and flaky center.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Lotus Seeds are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they are the result of [[Fleet-Lotus Seeds]] that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Roasted Lotus Seeds are said to have a soft and flaky center inside their outer shell. When eaten, they restore three-quarters of a [[Heart]] to [[Link]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Lotus Seeds reappear in {{TotK}} as a variety of [[Roasted Food]], which are created when [[Fleet-Lotus Seeds]] come into contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. By peeling away its out skin, one is able to reach a soft and flaky center. Eating Roasted Lotus Seeds will result in [[Link]] healing three-quarters of a [[Heart]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Fleet-Lotus Seeds * Food * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
